content.caption:
If I could go back to my 3rd year, this is the roadmap I’d follow.

You don’t need to know everything.
You just need to stay consistent.

📌 Pick one language.
📌 Practice DSA.
📌 Build projects.
📌 Learn Git & GitHub.
📌 Start your resume and LinkedIn early.

Your future self will thank you. 🌱

What year are you in right now?
